source.name: Team Bahrain Victorious: Bahrain Victorious Unveils 2026 Alé Team Kit
source.quote: Team Bahrain Victorious today presents its new Alé team kit
source.note: The launch photo (https://bahraincyclingteam.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/CL_BAH_141225_studio-108-1.jpg) shows the 'Business Friendly Bahrain' mark on the upper chest; Alé's render in TOUR's article (https://res.cloudinary.com/delius-klasing-eu/image/upload/v1767869731/tour/ale-team-bahrain-victorious-new-kit-2026_321736fbbe36141263f9ccc96296f427.jpg) shows it on both sides of the chest. The team's About page lists the Bahrain Economic Development Board among its backers.

source.name: Cyclingnews — Bahrain Victorious announce 2026 bike sponsor (Tom Wieckowski)
source.quote: Bahrain Victorious have partnered with Bianchi as the official bike supplier for the 2026 racing season and beyond

summary: 2026 UCI WorldTeam kit by Alé, with BAHRAIN VICTORIOUS across the chest. From the launch photos: Bapco Energies on the front, BEYON and NBB on the upper chest, 'Business Friendly Bahrain' on the chest, alba on the collar, OMNIYAT on the sides and sleeves, Al Salam Bank on the sleeves, Bianchi on the chest and sleeves. Not complete: no back view was found, Mumtalakat's place isn't confirmed, and the United Shipping mark on the chest and further partners (Rudy Project, Vision, Continental and others) aren't itemised.
